'''Oranessan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]].

==Description==
Oranessan was a clouded, stormy world, that was located near to the termini of a number of different [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes.<ref name="Atlas Extra" /> The world was also polluted and ravaged.<ref name="Atlas Extra" />

==History==
Between [[3701 BBY]] and [[3699 BBY]], the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] was charted through Oranessan as part of the [[Seswenna Expansion]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

During the [[New Sith Wars]], Oranessan fell under the control of the [[Daimanate]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] state that was ruled by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]]. The Sith Lord used Oranessan as a transport center, from which support [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] were dispatched to the Daimanate frontiers. However, due to its distance from the Daimanate borders, the planet was only lightly defended.<ref name="Atlas Extra" />

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] planned to carry out a raid on Oranessan, but when the Order received word that [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations had commenced on the Daimanate world [[Chelloa]], they instead planned to make a strike against the Sith on Chelloa, with the Oranessan operation constituting the first stage of the attack. The mission became known as [[Operation Influx]]<ref name="Atlas Extra" /> and was put into action in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]] by a team of Jedi under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]]. The Jedi inserted on Oranessan in a captured Daimanate [[personnel shuttle]], and while posing as [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], Treece and the Jedi [[Kerra Holt]] and [[Dorvin Eltrom]] commandeered a [[Heavy-Lift Starcrosser|Daimanate Heavy-Lift Starcrosser]] from the Sith transport landing zone. The Jedi planned to use the transport to take them to Chelloa, but discovered that the transport's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] was missing its [[activation cylinder]]. Holt stole a replacement cylinder from a nearby hangar, and after fitting the device, the Jedi departed Oranessan.<ref name="Atlas Extra" />
